# Nancye D'Arienzo | Tucker Realty

> Nancye D'Arienzo is a licensed real estate agent with Tucker Realty, Powered by ERA, serving buyers and sellers in Mount Vernon and greater Skagit County, Washington. She has lived in Skagit County for 20 years and offers local expertise, honest guidance and full-service support from first conversation to closing.

## Business facts
- Business: Nancye D'Arienzo, Tucker Realty (Powered by ERA)
- Website: https://www.nancyedarienzorealty.com/
- Services: Home buying, home selling, listing and marketing support, local market guidance
- Service area: Mount Vernon, Skagit County, Washington, USA
- Address: 1932 E College Way Ste A, Mount Vernon, WA 98273
- Phone: (360) 941-5415
- Email: Nancyedarienzo25@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday - Saturday, 9:00 am - 7:00 pm
